Section 11.3: "The limitations in Sections 11.1 and 11.2 shall not apply to amounts payable under Article 10..."

Order Form No. 2, Section 3.1: "For purposes of the Agreement and all Order Forms, "Licensed Facilities" means the following facilities:" The table lists only the Hunts Point Plant and the Mount Vernon Plant.

Section 3.2: "Upon expiration of the Initial Term, this Agreement will automatically renew for successive 36-month terms ... unless either Party gives the other written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days prior to the expiration of the then-current term. Licensor may increase the Fees for any Renewal Term by up to twelve percent (12%)..." Section 15.6: "No Order Form, invoice, purchase order, e-mail or other ordering or operational document constitutes notice under this Agreement."
